definitions.gloss: elder-sister figure; a woman who leads and looks after others
definitions.explanation: A capable, strong-minded woman whom others look up to and rely on, like a big sister. Originally the wife of a gang boss or a woman boss among outlaws; now usually affectionate and a little humorous. Also written {姐御|あねご}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姉御|あねご}だ。
examples.english: She is the big sister of the class.

examples.japanese: {姉御肌|あねごはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I asked for advice from a senior who is a natural big-sister type.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧ことがある⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姉御|あねご}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。
examples.english: Whenever there's a problem, everyone turns to Ms. Tanaka, the big-sister figure of the office.

notes:
The compound {姉御肌|あねごはだ} ("the big-sister type") is more common than the bare word and is a compliment: generous, decisive, protective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姉御肌|あねごはだ}: having a big-sister temperament
- {姉御|あねご}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: a big-sister figure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧: big brother; the male counterpart, also used of an admired older man
- ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧: one's own older sister; a family word only
